statement: Device sends a Table Load request to BUYPASS after receiving Download Indicator.
BUYPASS responds to Table Load request with Software Dial Load and Software IP Load Data Segments.
Device stores New Software Version, Software Terminal Record ID, Software Load Phone Number or IP/URL Address, Request Date, and Request Time from response.
At designated date/time, device dials Software Load Phone Number or IP/URL Address and initiates full application load.
Totals Request message contains Data Section No. 1 with Message Format Version Identifier and Number of Segments.
Totals Request message contains Data Section No. 3 with Totals Data Segment (Data Segment No. 105).
Totals Request messages do not contain Data Section No. 2, the Standard Message Data Segment.
All Totals Request messages contain Element Nos. 55 and 63.
Number of Segments has a fixed value of 01 for Totals Request messages.
Totals with Proprietary Data Load Request messages do not contain Data Section No. 2 (Standard Message Data Segment).
Totals with Proprietary Data Load Request contains Data Segment No. 116 in Data Section No. 3.
All Totals Request messages contain Element Nos. 55 and 63.
Number of Segments field has fixed value 01 for Totals with Proprietary Data Load Request.
There is no Field Separator between fields in this Table Load Request message.
Merchant Data Segment is sent only on a Table Load Response.
Dial String Data Segment sent only on a Table Load Response and a Phone Load Response.
Store and Forward Data segment sent only on a Table Load Response.
Load flag in merchant's profile must be set to PHON for Phone Load to take place.
Load Type fixed value 'P' indicates Partial Load for Phone Load Request.
There is no Field Separator between fields in the Phone Load Request message.
Dial String Data Segment is sent only on a Table Load Response and a Phone Load Response.
Information Byte fixed value identifies a Download Request.
Load Type fixed value D identifies a Date and Time Load.
Load Type field must have fixed value P indicating Partial Load.
Information Byte field must have fixed value indicating a Download Request.
There is no Field Separator between fields in the Software Load Request message.
Software Dial Load Data Segment sent only on a Software Load Response.
Software IP Load Data Segment sent only on a Software Load Response.
Proprietary Data Load Request messages do not contain the Standard Message Data Segment (Segment 100).
Proprietary Data Load Request Data Section No. 1 contains Message Format Version Identifier and Number of Segments.
Proprietary Data Load Request Data Section No. 3 contains the Proprietary Data Load Segment (Data Segment No. 118).
Number of Segments has a fixed value of 1 for this request.
This request does not contain the Standard Message Data Segment (Data Segment No. 100).
Proprietary Data Load Segment indicates this is a Proprietary Data Load Request.
All Proprietary Data Load Responses contain Data Section No. 1
All Proprietary Data Load Responses contain Data Section No. 3
There is no Field Separator between fields in the Moneris Key Load Request message.
Information Byte fixed value indicates a Download Request for Moneris Key Load.
Load Type must be fixed value K (Key Load) for Moneris Key Load Request.
Load Subtype must be fixed value M (Moneris Key Load) for Moneris Key Load Request.
Field Separators are present between Field No. 2 and Data Section No. 2, and between fields 3-6.
No Field Separators exist between Field Nos. 6-12; a Field Separator follows Field No. 12.
Number of Segments must be fixed value 01 in CA Public Key File Load Request message.
Maximum variable length of Proprietary Load Request Data is not to exceed 3,800 bytes.
Maximum variable length of Proprietary Load Response Data is not to exceed 3,800 bytes.
Prompt Code 903 is used for Site Configuration Data loads sent in a Proprietary Data Load request.
Store and Forward Data Segment is only sent in Table Load Response when Merchant Data Segment Card Type = 173.
Device always uses Block Number to track data block sent in Proprietary Data Load request.
If Proprietary Data Load request processing is interrupted, host knows Block Number of last complete block sent.
Block Number value 000 means device sends last block of site/fuel volume data in Proprietary Data Load request.
In a Table Load response, host sends Card Type multiple times to instruct device on accepted cards/features.
End-of-Load Indicator is used in the Table Load Response.
Firmware Version is required for Totals Requests, Table Load Request, and TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization Load Request.
Hardware Version is required for Totals Requests, Table Load Request, and TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization Load Request.
For Totals Requests, some devices send 8 bytes of length for Hardware Version instead of 4.
BUYPASS Device Type must be '+*' for the CA Public Key File Load Request.
For Totals Request messages, Element No. 63 and Data Segment 105 always follow this element.
In Totals Requests, Number of Segments is always followed by Totals Data Segment.
In Communications Test Requests, Number of Segments is always followed by Network Management Message.
Software Load Request Date is used in Software Dial Load Data Segment (DL4) and Software IP Load Data Segment (DL5).
Software Load Request Time used in Software Dial Load Data Segment and Software IP Load Data Segment.
Software Version is required for Totals Request, Table Load Request, and TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization Load Request.
For Table Load, Phone Load, Date and Time Load, or Software Load Requests, Terminal Identifier length is 13 bytes.
The value of Totals Date in a Totals Response can differ from the value sent in the Totals Request.
Load Subtype value 'M' indicates Moneris Key Load and appears in Moneris Key Load Request.
SPDH Header appears in both Moneris Key Load request and response messages.
COMMTEST is the Network Management Message used in Communications Test Request format.
A Totals Request (999999 - Shift Read and Reset) follows successful completion of a batch upload.
At end of business day, terminal sends Totals Request (222222 - Read and Cut Settlement) after last batch.
Read and Cut Settlement Totals Request option can be used only by variable-cut merchants.
Totals Date code of MMDDYY returns totals for transactions that settled on the specified date.
If merchant does not request read and cut totals, BUYPASS automatically closes business day at designated cut time.
Code 333333 produces same result as Read Only Settlement Totals Request (section 9.3.2.1).
For Totals Request messages, Element No. 63 and Data Segment No. 105 always follow this data element.
Totals Requests: Element 63 is always followed by Data Segment No. 105, Totals Data Segment.
Proprietary Data Load request message is a standalone request, initiated by device for full or supporting table load.
Locations get a Card Table load to the new version on their next Totals request after Global record update.
Customer Device Communications Test Request packet: STX, sequence number, packet identifier 84, message format ID 00, length 0x0012, data, CRC, ETX.
Length of following message field equals 0x0012 (18 bytes) for the communications test request.
POS application must be able to read Card Type codes 094, 095, 096 sent in Table Load response.
POS application must read Card Type codes 094, 095, 096 from Table Load response.
POS application must be able to read Card Type code (094, 095, 096) sent in the Table Load response.
POS application must be able to read Card Type codes 091 and 092 sent in the Table Load response.
POS application must read Card Type code 093 sent in Table Load response for Money Code.
